subject: data-model.md accuracy review — 10 corrections needed
body:
GP — reviewed docs/data-model.md against the live JSON Schema (data/schemas/practice-exam.schema.json) and 10 actual exam files. Here are all corrections:

--- TOP-LEVEL FIELD TABLE ---

1. `version` — listed as required string '2.0'. WRONG on both counts.
   - Required: NO. Schema marks it optional.
   - Type: schema defines as integer (minimum: 1). But all 10 actual files store it as string '2.0'. This is a schema-vs-data mismatch. Recommend: update schema to allow string OR migrate files to integer 2. For now, document as: optional, string (current practice).

2. `subtitle` — MISSING from field table. It IS required per schema. Add row:
   subtitle | string | yes | Standards covered, question count, estimated time.

3. `time_minutes` — MISSING from field table. Required per schema. Add:
   time_minutes | integer | yes | 10-180. Estimated completion time in minutes.

4. `created` — MISSING from field table. Required per schema. Add:
   created | string | yes | ISO 8601 date YYYY-MM-DD.

5. `created_by` — MISSING from field table. Required per schema. Add:
   created_by | string | yes | Agent or person who created the exam.

6. `schema_version` — MISSING entirely from doc. Present in all 10 exam files and in schema. Add:
   schema_version | string | no | Schema version this file targets. Pattern: N.N (e.g. '1.0').

7. Optional top-level fields not documented: `purpose`, `fr_approved`, `fr_approved_date`, `fr_approval_notes`. Add a brief 'Optional Fields' subsection.

--- INPUT FIELD TABLE ---

8. `inputs[].type` — listed as only 'number, text'. WRONG. Four types exist:
   number, text, dropdown, radio. Add dropdown and radio.

9. `inputs[].tolerance` — listed as 'yes (numeric)'. WRONG. It is optional per schema even for number inputs. Some number inputs (e.g. word-problem text-label numbers) legitimately omit it. Change to: no (recommended for number type).

--- GRAPH SPEC TABLE ---

10. Graph fields missing/wrong:
    - `graph.asymptotes`: listed as required object. WRONG. It is optional (null is valid) and only used in RP1-7 format. RP8-10 omit it entirely.
    - `graph.function_display` (string) — MISSING. Required in schema.
    - `graph.min_points` (integer, >= 3) — MISSING from doc.
    - `graph.x_range` (array [min, max]) — MISSING. Used by RP6+ as viewport spec.
    - `graph.y_range` (array [min, max]) — MISSING. Same.

--- QUESTION FIELD TABLE ---

11. Several required question fields missing from table:
    - `number` (integer) — required, display number.
    - `section` (string enum A/B/C/D) — required.
    - `standard` (string, pattern W[23].[a-e]) — required.
    - `type` (string enum, 14 valid values) — required, controls renderer.
    Optional question fields also missing:
    - `plus_minus` (boolean) — interchangeable x1/x2.
    - `feedback_wrong_parent` (string) — used in identify questions (RP1-7 format).
    - `feedback_wrong_intercepts` (string) — used in identify questions (RP1-7 format).

--- SUMMARY ---

The authoritative source for field definitions is data/schemas/practice-exam.schema.json (GI-owned). When in doubt, the schema wins. I can answer any follow-up questions about intent of any field.

RP11 manifest note: see separate message.

— GI
